instruction: How long is my longest Spotify playlist, in minutes, rounded to the nearest number?
notes: Read-only question task: the evaluation requires no database changes, so the model only gathers knowledge and ends with supervisor.complete_task(answer=longest-minutes). Knowledge flow mirrors the reference solution: show_profile gives the login username (supervisor email), show_account_passwords the spotify password, login the token; show_playlist_library reveals the library's playlist ids (library-listed), show_playlist reveals a playlist's songs (songs-listed), show_song reveals song durations (duration-known). The loops over all playlists and all songs are abstracted by representative objects library-playlist / playlist-song (at runtime the agent applies the show_playlist and show_song steps to every playlist and every song); after the durations are retrieved the answer object longest-minutes is computable (found-longest-minutes), which is the only task-specific goal condition and the precondition of supervisor-complete-task. The answer is the maximum playlist total duration converted to minutes and rounded to the nearest integer.
